newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Four die as train collides with car in Tajikistan.
newsitem.headline: Four die as train collides with car in Tajikistan.

text.p: Four people were killed when a passenger train collided with a car in western Tajikistan, an interior ministry spokesman said on Sunday.

The official said the collision, on a railway crossing, took place late on Saturday in the former Soviet republic's Gisar region, 35 km (22 miles) from the capital Dushanbe. The driver of the car and his three passengers were killed.
Police in the remote Central Asian republic are investigating the scene of the accident to find out who was responsible for the crash, the spokesman said.
